answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity may dock at the jetty after proving trade with 12 counterparties through the inlet, each verified by a payment thread. A newcomer posts a 60-credit bond, locked for 20 epochs and each counterparty attests one job. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 counterparties and 6,000 credits, while an honest agent pays one bond once and earns it back from trade, so honest work stays cheap and forgery is ruinous.
